long_biography.plain_text:
Al Fattan's official name appears in Arabic as Musabbeh Rashid Musabbeh Al Fattan Al Falasi, with Musabah, Musabeh and Mosbeh among English variants. Dubai promoted him to lieutenant general after a police career and identified him as director of the Ruler's Office. He has also served as chairman of Al Fattan Properties and vice-chairman of Noor Investment Group, roles that distinguish his public office from his commercial work.

His private-business connection centers on real estate. He has been named personally in property-development contracts and as a party to a share transfer involving an Al Fattan construction joint venture. Al Fattan Properties has operated in Dubai development since 1974, with projects spanning residential, commercial and mixed-use property. Public office and company chairmanship remain distinct roles; state assets and corporate properties retain their respective ownership. His commercial record establishes an operating relationship to real estate, while the origin, exact ownership percentage and full scale of his personal fortune remain undisclosed.
